title: Activate the 90-day affiliate experiment and record owner constraints
why: The experiment cannot be evaluated or safely automated unless dates, financial authority, identity rules, and prohibited actions are fixed.
verification_evidence: ventures/bidetfit/MISSION.md; ventures/bidetfit/DIARY.md

title: Audit available assets, hosting, repositories, accounts, and autonomy capabilities
why: Claims of autonomy must be based on deployed capabilities rather than chat assumptions.
verification_evidence: ventures/bidetfit/DIARY.md Day 1–2; ventures/bidetfit/DECISIONS.md D-001

title: Research and score commercially viable affiliate niches
why: The primary metric is verified commission, so niche choice must optimize buyer intent and achievable differentiation rather than personal preference.
verification_evidence: ventures/bidetfit/NICHE_SCORECARD.csv; ventures/bidetfit/DECISIONS.md D-003

title: Select BidetFit brand, niche, positioning, and initial business thesis
why: A narrow purchase blocker supports original utility and commercially relevant content without pretending to test products.
verification_evidence: ventures/bidetfit/DECISIONS.md D-003 and D-004

title: Define the MVP product, user journey, content architecture, and safety boundaries
why: A measurable compatibility workflow is more defensible than unsupported recommendations.
verification_evidence: ventures/bidetfit/CONTENT_MAP.csv; ventures/bidetfit/EDITORIAL_QUEUE.csv

title: Build the 11-page BidetFit public beta and browser-based fit checker
why: A real utility improves application credibility and creates a testable customer journey.
verification_evidence: ventures/bidetfit/public; scripts/sync_bidetfit.py; deployment workflow evidence

title: Deploy BidetFit to GitHub Pages and verify critical public routes
why: A build is not launched until the deployed artifact and critical routes are independently verified.
verification_evidence: GitHub Actions runs and public URLs; ventures/bidetfit/DIARY.md

title: Build the unattended six-hour operator, durable state, incident handling, and kill switch
why: The business needs external state and scheduled verification before it can be described as operationally autonomous.
verification_evidence: .github/workflows/bidetfit-operator.yml; ventures/bidetfit/scripts/operator.py; RUNS.csv

title: Fix Python standard-library shadowing in the unattended operator
why: A file named operator.py shadowed Python’s standard-library operator module, preventing the scheduled job from starting.
verification_evidence: GitHub Actions run 32868199605; DIARY.md

title: Fix false-negative deployment incident cleanup
why: Operational status must distinguish artifact failure from reporting-tool failure.
verification_evidence: GitHub Actions overlay run 32868820325; DIARY.md

title: Research post-launch competitors and narrow BidetFit differentiation
why: A broad fit quiz or generic buying-guide site is insufficient if existing products already cover those surfaces.
verification_evidence: ventures/bidetfit/DECISIONS.md D-008; DIARY.md

title: Adopt App Factory Operating Standard 1.1 and backfill canonical governance records
why: Chat-only history is not durable enough for an autonomous project, and Done claims need task, decision, prompt, time, and evidence records.
verification_evidence: GitHub PR #6 and merge 6f4ff67886167fa5defd7f7fc1dc162e6d5137af; Jira PCH-90 and PCH-103; Notion BidetFit project and BF-012 task; GitHub PR #7 and merge 4ca038e91779613bff86f9254ffa1ee1c52b50de; unattended operator run 32916545607; docs/TRACKER_LINKS.csv

title: Configure Search Console, analytics ownership, and indexing baseline
why: Without indexing and analytics coverage, the project cannot distinguish no demand from no discoverability or measurement failure.
verification_evidence: Future Search Console/analytics evidence

title: Reverify affiliate program terms and prepare owner-ready application package
why: Revenue cannot begin until exact current terms, owner eligibility, and merchant approval are known.
verification_evidence: ventures/bidetfit/AFFILIATE_PROGRAMS.csv and future application receipts

title: Define and implement the exact toilet-model × bidet-model compatibility data schema
why: The defensible product moat is precise evidence and preserved uncertainty, not broad unsourced recommendations.
verification_evidence: Future schema, fixtures, tests, and decision record

title: Publish toilet-model identification and printable measurement/photo tools
why: Many visitors cannot complete exact fit work until they find a model number and take consistent measurements/photos.
verification_evidence: Future public URLs, tests, and content-map updates

title: Design and implement Jira as the owner command and work-control plane
why: An autonomous system needs a durable owner inbox, priorities, dependencies, approvals, comments, and evidence outside one chat.
verification_evidence: Future Jira automation, workflow tests, and execution receipts

title: Provision BidetFit support mailbox, aliases, authentication, and routing
why: Automated customer operations cannot begin without a stable support identity and authorized mailbox access.
verification_evidence: Blocked on owner/admin alias and OAuth/2FA actions

title: Build private support-ticket datastore, message model, and retention controls
why: Support requires memory and auditability, but email content can contain personal, order, and sensitive information.
verification_evidence: Future schema, threat model, tests, and privacy approval

title: Implement cloud email intake, deduplication, threading, and queueing
why: The current six-hour GitHub operator does not watch Gmail or preserve customer threads.
verification_evidence: Future cloud trigger, logs, and end-to-end test

title: Connect an external model runtime for support classification and draft generation
why: This exact chat cannot wake itself; an API-accessible model or authorized external agent runtime is required for open-ended language work.
verification_evidence: Blocked on runtime/provider decision and any separate API billing approval

title: Define support taxonomy, approved knowledge base, response templates, and escalation matrix
why: Autonomous replies need approved business facts and action boundaries, not only a general model prompt.
verification_evidence: Future SUPPORT_RUNBOOK.md, templates, and approval record

title: Implement action-risk classification, authorization, approvals, receipts, and emergency controls
why: Prompt instructions alone cannot safely authorize email, account, order, refund, privacy, or destructive actions.
verification_evidence: Future authorization matrix, tests, and security review

title: Run a draft-only customer-support pilot and independent quality evaluation
why: Draft-first operation provides real evidence without risking unsupervised customer commitments.
verification_evidence: Future pilot dataset, review receipts, and experiment results

title: Enable narrowly scoped low-risk support auto-send categories
why: The goal is unattended service, but autonomy should expand by measured risk tier rather than all at once.
verification_evidence: Future approval packet, canary report, and production evidence

title: Implement authenticated customer, account, and order lookup
why: Order and return operations require identity, authorization, and tenant isolation.
dependencies: A future account/order system; BF-019, BF-023, BF-032
verification_evidence: Deferred until BidetFit owns customer accounts or receives delegated merchant access

title: Integrate seller or merchant order, cancellation, return, and refund APIs
why: BidetFit cannot process a merchant’s return merely because it referred the sale; it needs seller-of-record status or explicit delegated API authority.
verification_evidence: Deferred until business model and merchant relationship justify it

title: Implement RMA, return-label, replacement, cancellation, and bounded refund workflows
why: A return is a financial, inventory, legal, and customer-commitment workflow rather than a text response.
verification_evidence: Deferred until BidetFit is seller or has explicit merchant authority

title: Build the autonomous metrics, diagnosis, experiment, and learning loop
why: Automation without measurement repeats activity; learning requires hypotheses, baselines, outcomes, and behavior changes.
verification_evidence: Future collectors, experiment receipts, and evaluation reports

title: Add browser-level checker tests, accessibility checks, and synthetic production monitoring
why: The current deployment proof establishes reachability but not every checker journey.
verification_evidence: Future CI test reports and production smoke receipts

title: Implement owner notifications, escalation channels, and service health summaries
why: An unattended system needs a reliable human escalation route for approvals and incidents.
verification_evidence: Future notification tests and owner acknowledgment

title: Complete privacy, security, legal, and commercial-policy review for autonomous customer operations
why: Email support and returns introduce personal data, external commitments, and potentially financial actions beyond the current anonymous static site.
verification_evidence: Future approval record and exact policy artifact hashes

title: Launch autonomous customer operations v1
why: This is the practical milestone at which a customer can email while the laptop is off and receive a safe response.
verification_evidence: Blocked until all launch gates pass
